adjudication.rationale: In handleNewBooking.ts, evt.destinationCalendar is set to `eventType.destinationCalendar ? [..] : organizerUser.destinationCalendar ? [..] : null` (around lines ~1040-1066 in the diff). Later, for collective team events, the code does `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars);`. If both eventType and organizer lack a destinationCalendar, evt.destinationCalendar becomes null, so the optional-chained push is a no-op and any collected `teamDestinationCalendars` (built from other users’ destinationCalendar values) are silently not added. This is a correctness issue where collective team calendars can be dropped.
